text:
emma_sales: Hey team — MerchantX (fintech marketplace) wants to run a 4-week POC to validate checkout personalization + post-purchase summarization. From the call: they want embeddings search over order history, chat-based order summaries, and an on-prem/private option for PCI. They also asked for SSO/SCIM, SOC2 evidence, and a security questionnaire. Need: scope, success criteria, timeline, and rough pricing. Can we align quickly?

liam_se: Quick Q — do they need streaming responses or only synchronous chat? Also what's expected peak RPS?

nisha_presales: From the call notes: peak ~50 RPS, avg seq length ~256 tokens. They want p95 latency <= 200ms for chat. They explicitly said data cannot leave their VPC unless Private deployment approved.

oliver_security: Heads up — procurement will send a 40+ page security questionnaire. Primary blockers likely: SAML SSO, PCI requirements (cardholder data), KMS/HSM key control, and data residency. For Private on-prem we'll need to validate the customer's hardware profile and support window.

maya_customer_success: Proposed success criteria (we should push for measurable tests):
- Latency: p95 < 200ms for 1k synthetic checkout chat queries
- Quality: human eval on 200 prompts, target F1 >= 0.8 for slot extraction (promo code detection, shipping intent)
- Embeddings: recall@10 >= 0.90 on 1k order-history queries
- Security: passes automated SCA checklist, SSO working end-to-end, and signed DPA in place

liam_se: Implementation notes + endpoints we should test:
- /v1/chat (context up to 8k; streaming optional)
- /v1/embeddings (FAISS-backed index in Dedicated/private)
- /v1/summarize (post-purchase digest generator)
Sample prompt skeletons and eval harness I'll prepare. Model suggestion: open-variant-2.7b-quant for Dedicated trial, or hosted gptx-small for baseline comparisons.

zara_finance: Ballpark pricing for a 4-week dedicated evaluation + support: ~$18,000 base for reserved capacity + ~$8,000 one-time private/on-prem engineering support. Will refine with usage profile.

oliver_security: For the security questionnaire: ask them to provide expected data flows and a contact for their ATO team. We'll prepare: dataflow diagram, encryption-at-rest/in-transit specs, retention policy, and our SOC2 summary. Also request their minimum contractual terms for DPA and whether they require subprocessor list.

nisha_presales: I'll draft a compact POC plan today with prioritized MVPs (so we don't try to do everything):
1) Checkout personalization (priority 1) — embeddings + rerank for 80% of converted recommendations
2) Order-status chat summarization (priority 2) — end-to-end user -> summary in <200ms p95
3) Returns triage routing (priority 3) — classifier for common return intents
Each has explicit evals. Will post prompts, sample datasets, and an automated eval harness by EOD.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: POC-5691 MerchantX - infra provisioning request (owner: liam_se).

emma_sales: Awesome — next steps: nisha to post the POC plan + prompts, oliver to start the security template and question triage, liam to draft the runbook and sample traffic generator. Sync Thursday 10:00am PT to finalize scope. @zara_finance please confirm estimate before sync. :thumbsup:
